clips.title: The story
paras: Defias smugglers hold Jerod's Landing on the Elwynn Forest bank of the Nazferiti River. The dock gives them a hidden route for illicit shipments across the kingdom's waterways.

Defias outlaws now control the river dock at Jerod's Landing, where Elwynn Forest meets the waters of the Nazferiti River. Once an ordinary boat dock, it now receives goods plundered from the Redridge Mountains under a Defias dockmaster's watch. The outlaws move the cargo discreetly downstream toward holdings such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.
